facts.text: Medgar Evers College holds the distinction of being the youngest of the four-year senior colleges in The City University of New York.

sources.title: History - Medgar Evers College
sources.quote: Medgar Evers College has the distinction of being the youngest of the four-year senior colleges in The City University of New York.

facts.text: Medgar Evers College was officially established on July 30, 1970, when Governor Nelson A. Rockefeller signed legislation approving the four-year college.

sources.title: History - Medgar Evers College
sources.quote: The College was officially established on July 30, 1970 when Governor Nelson A. Rockefeller signed the legislation approving the “establishment of an experimental four-year college of professional studies offering both career and transfer associate degrees and the baccalaureate degree…”

facts.text: Medgar Evers College is funded by the U.S. Department of Education as a Predominantly Black Institution (PBI) under Title III.

sources.title: Predominantly Black Institutions - Medgar Evers College
sources.quote: Medgar Evers College Predominantly Black Institutions (PBI) program is funded by the U.S. Department of Education's Predominantly Black Institutions Title III Discretionary/Competitive grant
